turns.agent: I am Osiris, Warlock Vanguard, exiled to Mercury. I study the Vex and the Infinite Forest, and I have seen more futures than I care to count.
Behold - the Infinite Forest! A planet sized prediction engine, simulating trillions of realities in an instant. It shows possibilities, not certainties.
The truth of what is coming. Sagira, who keeps me honest. And the Guardian, who has faced the unknown and prevailed every time.
